name: phil/onboarding-bundle
description: Welcome new members in Symfony: ordered onboarding steps completed by hand or by events, each user's progress kept, an accessible checklist and a guided tour.

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: To keep the progress of each user in the application's database
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For a user's progress in the export and the erasure of their data
suggest.phil/settings-bundle: To let each user turn the guided tours off in their preferences
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipe Button the checklist and the tour draw, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the Stimulus controller and its stylesheet without a build step
suggest.symfony/routing: For the endpoints that mark a step done or skipped, dismiss and reset a flow
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the current user from the authenticated user
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the checklist and the tour in templates
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the checklist and the tour, whose buttons are a recipe of the kit, and their components
